title: fey flow diagram (anchored)
description: One entry-point flow, parsed from source (never run). Every node is anchored to a real span id from .fey/create/manifest.json, so the viewer can light the exact code a node stands for — the same anchor-then-generate rule as the wiki. `fey diagrams build` validates this shape and every anchor before writing. One entry point = one file = one diagram.

id.description: Stable slug for this diagram (kebab-case), unique across the run. Becomes the file name and the URL, e.g. 'post-checkout'.

entry.description: How control enters, in the reader's terms: 'POST /checkout', 'cli: migrate', 'main()', 'onMessage(order.created)'.

title.description: Short human title for the flow, e.g. 'Checkout request'.

kind.description: Entry-point family. Free-form but prefer one of the enum values for consistent grouping in the nav.

summary.description: 1-3 plain sentences: what this flow does end to end. Shown above the diagram.

lanes.description: The worldlines — coarse groupings that each become one vertical lane. A dozen lanes reads well; a hundred does not. Group by module/package/directory/layer, NOT one lane per file. Every node's `lane` must reference a lane `id` here.

id.description: Lane id referenced by nodes, e.g. 'api'.

nodes.description: The ordered call path. Each node is one call; `parent`+`order` form the tree the renderer draws as exchanges down the page.

id.description: Node id, unique within this diagram (e.g. 'n0').

lane.description: The lane id this node lives on (must exist in `lanes`).

anchor.description: Span id from manifest.spans ('<file>#<Symbol>') OR a line-range anchor ('<file>#L<start>-<end>'). Required for resolved:true nodes; the viewer lights this code when the node is clicked. Omit only when resolved is false.

parent.description: Node id of the caller, or null for the entry node. Must form a tree (no cycles).

order.description: Sequence index along the path (0-based). Determines vertical position; the entry node is order 0.

resolved.description: false when the callee could not be tied to a definition (dynamic dispatch, reflection, external lib). Renders dashed and needs no anchor. Defaults to true.

note.description: Optional one-line gloss shown on hover, e.g. 'raises on empty cart'.

branches.description: Optional alternate arms from the SAME entry point (error path, cache miss, retry) — the sum-over-diagrams family. Each item is a partial flow: a `label` plus its own `nodes` (same node shape). Static parsing can enumerate arms but not say which fires most often.
